purpose: Seventh-pass official and first-party source verification for three still-open Batch-51 current-operator conflicts while the same V53 task remains pickup-timeout claimable for the existing single coordinator. No second runner, task, checkpoint advancement, exact-parcel promotion or parcel-value publication is performed.

method.official_source_policy: Only primary auction pages, Companies House records, first-party operator pages and local-authority licensing or planning records are promoted. A pending licence application, active registered company or planning application does not alone prove lease assignment, legal completion or an open trading site.
method.parcel_binding_policy: NO_DATA_NOT_INFERRED until exact title or canonical geometry is read.

rows.address: 11 Murray Street, Filey, North Yorkshire, YO14 9DF
rows.resolved_fact: The Acuitus record preserves the December 2024 historical tenancy schedule for Captain Wills Bar, rear storage and CAPTAIN WILLS APARTMENTS LTD. North Yorkshire Council now publishes July-August 2026 current applications by Melly Group Limited for Fado & Tide at 9 and 11 Murray Street, including a premises-licence application for a cafe, bar and restaurant and a pavement-licence application. This is strong official evidence of a replacement operating-company candidate at the exact combined site, but the applications do not prove grant, opening, lease assignment or the continuing position of the flats and rear storage.

Companies House records SUGARCANE LTD as active at the exact address and the first-party Sugar Cane site states that the bar is closed until further notice. Wandsworth Council additionally records exact-site application 2025/1340 for frontage and pergola alterations, refused on 12 September 2025. These sources strongly verify the legal entity and physical site history while confirming that current trading cannot be treated as active; the planning applicant name is not used to infer a lease-party relationship.

rows.address: Lloyds Chambers, The Square, Barnstaple, Devon, EX32 8LS
rows.resolved_fact: The primary auction record and Companies House controlling-person record continue to support a D SCOFF'S LTD nexus at 1 The Square after SCOFFS ORIGINAL LIMITED was dissolved. A bounded Food Standards Agency search did not obtain an exact current restaurant registration for Lloyds Chambers or EX32 8LS, so physical occupation and lease transfer remain unpromoted rather than inferred.
